columns.name: IG Receipt ID
columns.comment: Service-owned primary asset ID in mw_agent; not an AppSheet Ref

columns.name: Receipt Image
columns.comment: Bucket-root AppSheet GCS reference: // followed by the immutable object key

columns.name: Receipt Received At
columns.comment: Durable ingress capture in Asia/Bangkok; not bank transfer time

constraints.name: payment_receipt_triplet
constraints.definition: CHECK ("IG Receipt ID" IS NULL AND "Receipt Image" IS NULL AND "Receipt Received At" IS NULL OR "IG Receipt ID" IS NOT NULL AND "IG Receipt ID" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND "Receipt Image" IS NOT NULL AND "Receipt Received At" IS NOT NULL)

triggers.name: a00_receipt_evidence
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER a00_receipt_evidence BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON "Payments" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_payment_receipt_evidence()

routines.name: attach_payment_receipt_evidence
routines.arguments: p_payment text, p_receipt text, p_key text, p_captured timestamp with time zone, p_expected jsonb, p_operation uuid, p_code_version text
routines.arguments_with_defaults: p_payment text, p_receipt text, p_key text, p_captured timestamp with time zone, p_expected jsonb, p_operation uuid, p_code_version text

routines.name: guard_payment_receipt_evidence
